title: Name lore check as a required check on main in CLAUDE.md
description: User approved (2026-09-15, direct AskUserQuestion, not a relay) adding 'lore check' to ruleset 22669384 require-ci-on-main. The ruleset was updated and re-read live: main now requires 'check · manifests', 'Tracker integrity' and 'lore check'. CLAUDE.md's Contributing section still names only the first two, and the required-checks paragraph in the ruleset also drives the DEC-1 promotion gate wording. Follow-up to OMARK-52.

acceptanceCriteria.text: CLAUDE.md Contributing section names all three required checks on main: check · manifests, Tracker integrity, lore check
The text says what lore check validates and where its CLI versions are derived from, in one or two sentences

finalSummary: Ruleset 22669384 require-ci-on-main now requires check · manifests, Tracker integrity and lore check (PUT applied after the user's direct approval, re-read live). CLAUDE.md's Contributing section names all three and says the lore/quest versions are derived from the opum-lore pin and the managed block. Delivered in PR #101, CI run 34990451593, all three jobs green.
